title: Release 1.4.0
description:
Cut, verify and publish the **1.4.0** release.

Run from the repository root; the book lives in `examples/`, so `defaults.cwd` points one level up.

steps.title: Check the working tree is clean
steps.description: A release should start from a clean tree. If this prints changes, commit or stash them first.

steps.title: Run the test suite
steps.description: Everything must be green before tagging.

steps.title: Build the CLI
steps.description: Produces `build/drill`. Swap in your own build command.
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p build
go build -trimpath -o build/drill ./cmd/drill
./build/drill version

steps.title: Validate every book in the repository
steps.description: A release should not ship runbooks that no longer parse.

steps.title: Post the release notes
steps.description:
Copy the changelog into `#releases` and link the tag.

No command: this step is a checklist item, because a human does it.
